explanation: Compared against OEIS A228425 (Sun): 'any integer n > 1 can be written as x + y (x, y > 0) with p_k(x) + p_{k+1}(y) prime, if and only if k is among 3, 39, 99', with p_m(x) = (m−2)x(x−1)/2 + x. The Lean statement for k ≥ 3 (the polygonal range m > 2 used in the entry) is (∀ n > 1, ∃ x, y > 0, x + y = n, p_k(x) + p_{k+1}(y) prime) ↔ k ∈ {3, 39, 99}, with Nat.polygonalNumber matching the entry's formula. Faithful.
